26.original: Deliver the stalks of golden barley to the venerable villager.

27.original: Deliver the bottle of Wright ale to the bonded servant.

48.original: Excuse me, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>, but you are a fellow visitor here, yes? I wonder if you would be willing to perform for me a trifling service...

49.original: I serve a particular family of the Eulmoran elite, and it is at the behest of my patron─a man with a discerning taste for fine drink─that I have ventured to the famous breweries of Wright.

50.original: Oh, do you not partake yourself? Otherwise you would surely be aware of Wright's incomparable ale, and its glowing reputation amongst the privileged of Eulmore!

51.original: In recent years, however, it seems distribution of this golden liquid has ground to a halt, and thus have I been sent to make a purchase directly from the source.

52.original: A simple task, you might think...except the people of Wright are not overly receptive to visitors from Eulmore. Downright dismissive, in fact!

53.original: Do you understand my dilemma? I need you to speak to the villagers, and procure a supply of ale in my stead─a service for which you will be paid most handsomely!

54.original: Pray bargain with the villagers on my behalf, and I shall see you rewarded for any ale you acquire.

55.original: Hm? You're wantin' to buy some Wright ale?

56.original: Well now, we was indeed famous for our ale once, but that age is long past...

57.original: Any barley we grow these days is bound for the oven or the cookin' pot─there's naught to be spared for brewin' beers and the like.

58.original: You put that young back to work bringin' in the harvest, though, and I might be convinced to part with a bottle from my private stock...

59.original: Help me harvest the field there, and I'll see what ale I've got left hidin' in the larder.

60.original: You've brought me my barley, then?

61.original: Thank you, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>. There's fewer hands around to help out ever since the... <cough>

62.original: It's a good drop, our Wright ale is. Slides down the throat like honeyed sunshine, so they say, and afore you know it you've downed the whole damn bottle.

63.original: Drink it slow and easy, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>, or you'll be wakin' up with a sore head come the morrow!

64.original: Were you successful in your bargaining?

65.original: I see... That would explain why the trickle of ale into Eulmore has ceased altogether. I shall report this situation to my patron, and see what can be provided in the form of laborers and surplus comestibles.

66.original: In any case, I thank you for securing this precious bottle, kind traveler! Your payment, as promised...
